mapper.select: SELECT status FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, real_name, phone FROM patient_profile WHERE id = #{profileId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.doctor_id, s.department_id, d.name AS doctor_name, dep.name AS department_name, d.status AS doctor_status, dep.status AS department_status, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.total_slots, s.booked_slots, s.status, s.cancel_before_minutes FROM doctor_schedule s INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = s.doctor_id AND d.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN department dep ON dep.id = s.department_id AND dep.deleted = 0 WHERE s.id = #{scheduleId} AND s.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE OF s
SELECT id FROM doctor_schedule WHERE id = #{scheduleId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor_schedule SET booked_slots = booked_slots + 1, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{scheduleId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND start_time > DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL cancel_before_minutes MINUTE) AND booked_slots < total_slots
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, s.cancel_before_minutes FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN doctor_schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
SELECT a.*, s.cancel_before_minutes FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN doctor_schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE OF a

SELECT a.*, s.cancel_before_minutes FROM appointment a INNER JOIN doctor_schedule s ON s.id = a.schedule_id WHERE a.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') AND a.patient_user_id = #{patientUserId} ORDER BY a.id FOR UPDATE OF a
SELECT DISTINCT schedule_id FROM appointment WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') ORDER BY schedule_id
SELECT DISTINCT schedule_id FROM appointment WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') ORDER BY schedule_id
SELECT DISTINCT schedule_id FROM appointment WHERE patient_user_id = #{patientUserId} AND deleted = 0 AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED') ORDER BY schedule_id
SELECT id FROM doctor WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'PENDING' AND doctor_id = #{doctorScope}

choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_profile_id) FROM appointment WHERE deleted = 0 AND doctor_id = #{doctorScope}
